points.quote: Live in `src/vs/**/test/` folders, next to the code they cover. The project docs say they use `describe`/`test`.
Run them with `scripts/test.sh`, or `scripts\test.bat` on Windows. Add `--grep` or `--run <file>` to narrow the selection. ... `scripts/test.sh` uses the Electron variant
`npm run test-browser` runs the browser variant through Playwright. `npm run test-node` runs the node variant with mocha.
Run them with `scripts/test-integration.sh`, or `scripts\test-integration.bat` on Windows.
Extension-hosted tests live inside the extensions, for example `extensions/*/src/test` and `extensions/vscode-api-tests`.
Live in `test/smoke`. They drive the full product UI end to end. Run them with `npm run smoketest`, which compiles first.
Runners are in `test/unit/`... Live in `test/integration/`... Live in `test/smoke`... Live in `test/sanity`. They check published release builds
Build the client output before running tests. `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` does that.
